events.title: Dinner switched from à la carte to set menu
events.label: Set menu at dinner
events.detail: Brasserie Central serves a fixed three-course dinner menu from 1 September 2026.

events.title: Published rate +15% for October (trade-fair season)
events.label: Published rate +15%
events.detail: Applies to stays from 1 to 31 October 2026. Corporate and travel-agent contract rates are unchanged.

events.title: Housekeeping: 4 staff on sick leave, agency cover until 24 Oct
events.label: Housekeeping sick leave
events.detail: Agency housekeepers cover 6–24 October 2026 at a premium. 6 rooms are out of service from 8 to 17 October.

events.title: Two corporate accounts cut Q4 travel budgets
events.label: Corporate budgets cut
events.detail: Both accounts have paused non-essential travel to Brussels until the end of December 2026.

events.title: Book direct, free breakfast (May–Aug)
events.label: Book-direct offer
events.detail: Breakfast included for bookings made on the hotel website, stays from 1 May to 31 August 2026.

events.title: Half board ended for midweek stays
events.label: Half board ended
events.detail: From 7 September 2026, dinner at Mar Azul is no longer included in stays from Monday to Thursday.

events.title: Booking.com Genius −15%, 1–31 Oct
events.label: Genius −15%
events.detail: Genius members get 15% off the published rate on Booking.com for stays in October 2026.
